'''Robert Frost''' of Essex Junction, Vermont, was the first of 1,040 correct entries for Puzzle 4 of the 1997 Dagobah Contest, [[Wars Not Make One Great]]. He won a display box of white-border Premiere packs.<ref name="sol4">[http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution4.html The Dagobah Contest], Decipher (March 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19970327214430/http://rothko.decipher.com/new/dagobahcontest/solution4.html Internet Archive]</ref>
